hack.root_cause: Fake jar injection — missing whitelist in Controller's jar-swap function
hack.description: Pickle Finance lost 19.7M DAI when an attacker injected a fake "Pickle Jar" into the Controller contract and swapped funds from the legitimate cDAI jar — exploiting a missing whitelist in code added after the protocol's two audits.
